name: task-3-distribution-playwright-tests
description: Playwright validations for Distributions and Transactions

scripts.test:period: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const period = process.argv[1] || ''; const spec = process.argv[2] || ''; if (!period) { console.error('Usage: npm run test:period -- YYYY-MM [tests/file.spec.js]'); process.exit(1); } const env = { ...process.env, TEST_PERIOD: period }; const args = ['playwright', 'test']; if (spec) args.push(spec); const result = spawnSync('npx', args, { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true, env }); process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
